alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 26 at 4:26PM CST until November 26 at 9:00PM CST by NWS Memphis TN
alerts.areaDesc: Clay; Greene; Craighead; Mississippi; Dunklin; Pemiscot; Lake; Obion; Weakley; Dyer; Gibson; Lauderdale; Crockett
alerts.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by going to
weather.gov/meg/roadconditions
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Wet snow. Additional snow accumulations up to one inch.

* WHERE...Portions of East Arkansas, Southeast Missouri, and West
Tennessee.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM CST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Thanksgiving Day commute.

alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 26 at 3:06PM CST by NWS Paducah KY
alerts.areaDesc: Fulton; Hickman; Carlisle; Perry; Bollinger; Cape Girardeau; Wayne; Carter; Ripley; Butler; Stoddard; Scott; Mississippi; New Madrid
alerts.description:
Temperatures will get down to around freezing tonight in
southeast Missouri and western portions of the Purchase region in
Kentucky. As rain comes to an end in these areas late tonight, the
potential for black ice will increase. Take precautions when
traveling especially on untreated roads, bridges, and overpasses.

alerts.headline: The Winter Weather Advisory has been cancelled.
alerts.description: The Winter Weather Advisory has been cancelled and is no longer in effect.
